subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with details be suppressed before mutating-tool warning handling, including cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose cases, or should those detail-warning paths remain visible?
rationale: Current tests intentionally surface some includeDetails exec warnings, while this PR asks to suppress them; automation cannot safely choose which user-visible warning contract maintainers want.

options.title: Clarify And Encode Policy First
options.body: Decide the intended exec-like detail-warning contract, then revise the code and tests so mutating, cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose cases all follow it consistently.

options.title: Preserve Current Detail Warnings
options.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec warnings visible and close or narrow this PR to only a proven leakage case.

options.title: Accept Suppress-All Exec-Like Warnings
options.body: Move suppression ahead of mutating handling and update the existing detail-mode tests to document the deliberate behavior change.

recommendation.title: Clarify And Encode Policy First
recommendation.body: Decide the intended exec-like detail-warning contract, then revise the code and tests so mutating, cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose cases all follow it consistently.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent refactors put this warning-policy/mutation helper surface closest to vincentkoc.
